intro.fr: Mercenaries: Playground of Destruction se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Mercenaries: Playground of Destruction can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Pandemic Studios sort Mercenaries: Playground of Destruction en 2005.
text.en: Pandemic Studios releases Mercenaries: Playground of Destruction in 2005.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub ToxicFrog/mercs-ap, qui héberge l'APWorld de Mercenaries: Playground of Destruction.
text.en: The GitHub repository ToxicFrog/mercs-ap, home of the Mercenaries: Playground of Destruction APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Comme beaucoup de jeux, Mercenaries: Playground of Destruction rejoint Archipelago par un APWorld non officiel : un fichier .apworld distribué à part, que chaque joueur ajoute lui-même à son installation pour l'intégrer à un multiworld.
text.en: Like many games, Mercenaries: Playground of Destruction joins Archipelago through an unofficial APWorld: a .apworld file distributed separately, which each player adds to their own install to bring it into a multiworld.
